_schema.description: Manual attribution overrides for filings whose target prop + stance are DEFINITE but the resolver can't extract them automatically. Codex round-9 rule: only single-target, fully-documented cases.
_schema.key_format: Either a CAL-ACCESS filer_id (numeric string) or a normalized filer name (lowercase, whitespace-collapsed)
_schema.value_format: Array of [finance_campaign_id, stance] tuples. Length 1 = single-target (attribution_method='manual_override'). Length >1 = multi-target (resolver returns ambiguous_multi_prop unless row-level fields disambiguate, e.g. EXPN_CD with BAL_NUM per line).
curation_rules: Only add entries where target prop + stance are definite based on documented evidence
If unsure, add to known_unattributed_vehicles.json instead
Include 'rationale' in a sibling key starting with _ if useful (parser ignores _-prefixed keys)

examples_to_consider_for_future_curation.Citizens for Paycheck Protection 2005 sp: Target = PROP_75_2005 oppose (Paycheck Protection initiative was Prop 75 2005). Document Schedule A/C contributions before adding.
examples_to_consider_for_future_curation.Alliance for a Better California 2005: Multi-target: spans Schwarzenegger reform props 73-77 oppose. Probably NOT a single-target override; consider known_unattributed_vehicles.
